<a id="vercel"></a>
### Vercel (MCP + CLI)

`Vercel MCP tools / vercel CLI` · connector · **core** · phases: Build, Ship, Handover

Hosting: create projects, deploy, preview URLs, env vars, domains, logs, rollbacks, project transfer.

**Use when**
- Every deploy; reading runtime errors; adding env vars; connecting a domain

**Avoid when**
- Storing secrets in the repo (use env vars)

**How to use**
- Connect the GitHub repo once: every push makes a preview, merge to main = production
- Debug prod with get_runtime_errors then get_runtime_logs
- Set a Content-Security-Policy and security headers in vercel.json (see docs/stack/05-performance-and-privacy.md)

**Pairs with:** [GitHub (gh CLI / MCP)](ship.md#github) · [Shipping & Launch](ship.md#shipping-and-launch)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/stack/03-github-vercel-workflow.md](../../docs/stack/03-github-vercel-workflow.md)

**Docs:** https://vercel.com/docs
